The ICF has approved this program for Level 1 Accreditation, and it meets the coaching education hours required for the ACC Credential.

This Certification Starter Track is ideal for those seeking to formalise their coaching skills to meet industry standards, even without prior training. 

It is a great starting point for anyone exploring professional coaching as a possible career.


Investing in What Matters Most

The investment reflects the depth of training, the calibre of faculty and the structured support you receive across the full Professional Track.

To keep the programme accessible in different parts of the world, fees are set regionally and reflect local economic conditions.

In most regions, the indicative fees are from USD 2,700 to USD 3,500



Ready to Onboard

If this program aligns with where you want to grow, we invite you to complete the Interest Form to begin the process. 

Once the form is submitted, our team will arrange a brief conversation with you.

This allows us to confirm alignment, clarify expectations, and provide the full program details along with the regionally appropriate course fee.

Or you can book an appointment and speak with our friendly team to learn more about the program.

Complete the Interest Form  Book An Appointment  

For more information, you can email us at info@coachmastersacademy.com
